programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Country music is a key part of American culture.Thanks to contemporary artists such as Taylor Swift and Beyonce, the genre is attracting new generations of listeners.During his visit to Nashville, Marcin Prokop tries to understand what makes country more than just music.He meets with the artists' agent, visits an independent music studio where he observes a recording session, and talks to the curator of the legendary Ryman Auditorium.He also discovers a unique Polish exhibit in a private automotive museum.During his journey, he meets Tomek Wosiak, an emigrant from Gdynia, a renowned chef and manager of popular restaurants in the USA, who cooperates with the biggest stars.

programs.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programs.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programs.title: Ed Stafford: First Man Out
programs.desc: British survival school champion, Ed Stafford, competes with other veterans in this art.Participants will try to get out of the most hostile areas of Asia.

programs.title: Man v Food 2
programs.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska reaches Ghana, where she takes part in an important event - a funeral.In this country, the social status of the deceased is determined by the way of mourning, the number of mourners and the shape of the coffin.Veronica is a professional crier.He supports himself and his sons from his salary.It offers clients, among others:crying with falling to the ground, convulsions or squirrel crying.The traveler also talks to Paa Joe - a world-famous coffin artist.His work was purchased, for example, by Jimmy Carter, the president of the United States.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is going to Austria.There he meets an extraordinary gymnast, Jennifer Bricker-Bauer, who... was born without legs.Shortly after being born, she was abandoned in the hospital.Her adoptive parents gave her a great will to fight and also taught her not to use words such as "I can't", "I can't do it" or "I can't".She reached for the dreams that were within her reach and achieved success.Now he infects others with his optimism and motivates them.The story of the heroine of the third episode is a great example that the best scripts are written by life, and insurmountable barriers simply do not exist.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: There are still places where education remains a luxury that many children can only dream of.These include Bangladesh - a small country in South Asia, one of the most densely populated and poorest in the world.An area twice as large as Poland is inhabited by as many as 170 million people.At the same time, 20% of the population lives below the poverty line.Obtaining an education gives you a chance to improve your financial situation.Unfortunately, the monsoons that hit Bangladesh every year cut off 1/4 of its area from the rest of the world, including schools.To help thousands of children, squares, libraries and educational centers were created... on boats.He studies there, among others:Rabija, the youngest heroine of Martyna Wojciechowska's program so far.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Prague, Czech Republic, where she plans to talk about... sex.The heroine of the episode is Vladana Augsten, a professional who treats sexuality through touch.She is a certified sexual assistant for disabled people, one of eleven in the Czech Republic.In Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, this profession is widely known, but in this post-communist country it appeared for the first time only five years ago.Organizations training people involved in it also received funding from the state.One of them is the Freya Foundation.The sexuality of disabled people remains a taboo.Parents not only avoid the topic, but even make it difficult for their children to establish closer relationships, wanting to spare them pain and disappointment.The goal of Vladana and other sexual assistants is to support clients in their pursuit of independence.
